name: @dataflow-visualizer/host
description: Runtime bootstrap for the dataflow visualizer

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=external -e @dataflow-visualizer/interop -e @dataflow-visualizer/layout -e @dataflow-visualizer/protocol -e @dataflow-visualizer/query -e @dataflow-visualizer/renderer-svg -e @dataflow-visualizer/runtime && bun build src/browser.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming 'browser.iife.[ext]' --target browser --format iife --sourcemap=external && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
